venue: Fort Worth, Texas (Von Erich territory, World Class roots)
context: First SmackDown after WrestleMania 42. Post-Mania draft/shuffle energy. Texas crowds carry generational wrestling memory.

segments.outcome: Backstage arrivals. Cody (broken orbital) arrives as champion. Trick + Lil Yachty arrive (rapper attached). Danhausen in scene.
segments.notes: Locker-room census. Institution shows who's load-bearing.

segments.outcome: Fatu opens in-arena. (Detail not logged in markdown — structurally the opening shot of the WHC challenger.)
segments.notes: Power position to Fatu — first show after WM42, free-agent aitu.

segments.outcome: Giulia vs Tiffany announced. Kiana 'us' language but blamed Kathy for tension. Ally-to-challenger pipeline begins.
segments.notes: Joe's prediction logged: Kiana turns within 2 months. Giulia roster note: half-Japanese, half-Italian — syncretic.

segments.outcome: Tiffany Stratton def. Giulia (Women's US Title) clean. Kiana's interference attempt failed. Stratton kissed bicep — Hogan/Papa Pump energy.
segments.notes: Kiana showed her hand. Pipeline accelerated by visible-failure.

segments.outcome: Brie led 'welcome back' chant for Paige. Reign establishment promo.
segments.notes: Inanna's return received with conscious gratitude. Bellas as gatekeepers who opened the underworld door.

segments.outcome: Charlotte/Alexa vs Paige/Brie ended DQ — Fatal Influence (Jacy + Fallon) interfered, attacked both teams. Paige/Brie retain.
segments.notes: NXT call-up debut. 'Taking over SmackDown' announced. YES YES YES chant for Brie (Danielson by proxy). Lexi/Ashley at zero-gimmick — transparency-potency live.

segments.outcome: Priest & R-Truth def. MFTs clean. Pin on the biggest MFT member (Talla). Anubis passed judgment on the war-cult.
segments.notes: MFT enforcer pinned clean = signal 'we're moving on'. War-cult collapsing in real time.

segments.outcome: Miz + Danhausen vignette → Trick + Yachty scene. Gingerbread mascot breaks out and attacks. Sami inside the costume — laid Trick out. No promo.
segments.notes: Trojan horse: Sami used Sacred Clown's comedy register as cover. Predecessor descent begins. WM42 callback — Trick beat Sami for US title.

segments.outcome: Champion with the black eye. 'I always get back up' — property-frame, not moment-frame. Crowd approved.
segments.notes: Wound is the credential, not the liability. Fatal Influence replay aired during segment.

segments.outcome: Solo approached Royce Keys (Andre BR winner). Chief-usurper reasserting dominance after MFT implosion. Match TBD.
segments.notes: Recruitment opener. The anointed-unknown gets institutional attention.

segments.outcome: Danhausen def. Miz. Finish: Undertaker sit-up → 'You are cursed' → laugh → win. Kit Wilson with Miz — succession pipeline noted.
segments.notes: Sacred Clown quoting departed mythology through comedy register. Transparency-potency in three moves.

segments.outcome: Rhea wins by DQ — Fatal Influence interference (second DQ of the night for them).
segments.notes: Macha didn't lose, but was swarmed. FI's main-roster identity: can prevent a clean night.

segments.outcome: Fatu def. Solo clean. Pre-match: Tama mic-grab from Solo, Fatu superkicked Tama. Post-match: Fatu beat the entire MFT faction. Usos watched from apron. Fatu to Usos: 'I see y'all on Raw'.
segments.notes: Free-agent aitu beat the chief clean. MFTs functionally dead. Cross-brand declaration — declares for Raw.
